title: Naturality of the explicit Roos inclusion and projection
statement: Under the hypotheses and for the explicitly constructed maps of [lem-pe-roos-pointwise-exact], every strict tower morphism f:K->L makes both endpoint squares commute: C(H^(q-1)(f)) followed by a(L,q) equals a(K,q) followed by H^q(Roos(f)); and H^q(Roos(f)) followed by b(L,q) equals b(K,q) followed by lim H^q(f). This statement asserts only naturality, not existence or exactness. Here C and the cohomology towers are [def-pe-milnor-towers].

source.place: First paragraph: cone long exact sequence, extraction, product comparison, inverse limit and naturality

proof.text: The equality f_n t_n = t_n f_(n+1) makes the diagonal product map commute with 1-T. Its map on the two mapping-cocone summands commutes with the cone inclusion and projection. The connecting morphism for the distinguished triangle is natural.

The product/homology comparison commutes with the diagonal product map, as checked after every projection. Cancel the cokernel projection for the left square and compose with the kernel inclusion for the right square. The kernel-to-limit comparison is natural since each limit projection is the corresponding product coordinate. Transport these equalities along the explicit endpoint isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem roos_cohomology_naturality {A : Type a} [Category.{b} A] [Abelian A]
    [HasCountableLimits A] [HasExactLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) A]
    (q : ℤ) {K L : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    milnorTowerCokernelMap (Functor.whiskerRight f
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (q - 1))) ≫
        milnorInclusion L q =
      milnorInclusion K q ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (WeilConjectures.integralOperationsRoosMap f) q ∧
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (WeilConjectures.integralOperationsRoosMap f) q ≫
        milnorProjection L q =
      milnorProjection K q ≫ limMap (Functor.whiskerRight f
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) q))
